issueObservations.rationale: The public matrix and the 3.2.0 changelog still disagree about release timing. The base image, specific patch and Kubernetes tuple are independently scoped to current Operator documentation with no future 11.x conclusion.

The 10.4 upgrade topic describes complete removal for Enterprise inter-component traffic on all OSes, while the release table describes a default-off temporary migration setting. Live reports preserve the discrepancy.

The older installer and SAIA-9918 still document the Cloud Connected 2.2–2.3.6 restriction and 2.1.1 base-only workaround. The 2.4 Cloud Connect installer is a separate documented path with its own Platform, app, license and certificate floors.

Agent Mode requires an enabled Model Runtime and supported AWS service location. The applicable runtime standard still describes zone/global routing separately; a listed feature location does not establish processing or authorization for a tenant.

The read-only subagent requires AI Assistant 2.2.0+, ITSI 5.0.0+, MCP Server 1.2.1+ and permissions. The base-assistant public install table does not establish subagent-specific geography or an exact pairing.

Two current Splunkbase app 1841 responses list Platform 10.4 through 10.8 for package release ID 125032. The preceding observation of the same ID included 10.2 and 10.3. The versioned Help 10.2.x row still says generic 5.0. Exact patch applicability remains unresolved and the publication still shows the prior tags.
The current issue table attributes ITSI-46607 to 5.0.0. The Service Discovery article supports the feature independently; preserve the issue version distinction in the 5.0.3 guide.
The current known-issues table explicitly includes ITSI-46608 under 5.0.3 with its stated condition. The update does not establish a fix or derive a deployment rollout.

The November milestones, official host-based edition table and separate Collector requirements were read today. Both public report origins displayed the edition’s shared and Premier-only capabilities, customer realm and tenant qualifiers, and the precise link in screen, offline HTML and PDF.
The Assistant page describes prior-chat selection and a separate 30-day window for the most recent interaction supplied as context. The screened public guidance retains this boundary.

The July RCA topic limits automated detection to supported built-in metrics and describes opt-in/manual start. Later recommendations for creating custom metrics are a separate capability and do not expand detectors.
The AI Assistant lists us3. The service description does not establish a corresponding public geographic placement for that service realm, and the troubleshooting agent has its own conditions.
The current App for SOAR prerequisites have the literal 8..0 on-premises tested cell. The exact on-premises pairing remains unknown; independent App and platform releases do not fill it.

Fresh rendered WebKit shows seven fixed rows under the on-premises Release 8.8.0 heading. The introduction still labels 8.7.0. PSAAS-36070 and PSAAS-36084 individually name Cloud and on-premises. The earlier unrendered capture and received denial are retained separately.

The Cloud and Enterprise Export prerequisite tables are distinct from the 8.8.1 application release note. The exact tested pairing is limited to the versioned matrix and does not follow from the new export release number.
Broker release notes list 8.7.0.245 and identify Docker Hub as the maintenance distribution. No broad SOAR service deployment follows.

The 8.8 Agentic AI offerings parent advertises ES 8.6 or higher for Cloud. Prerequisite wording in the detailed current/historical path, scope differences, paired SOAR and independent limits remain separate. No exact pairing or entitlement follows.

The former named paths did not return the required topics. Current 8.8 Agentic AI offerings and Triage/Response setup were actually read at their renamed official URLs; this resolves the bounded source locator check while preserving old access failures.
